description: This file contains unit tests for the ReconnectActor component in the Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging service, testing connection recovery, ID conversions, and reconnection initiation behaviors.

classes.name: ReconnectActorTest
classes.description: Unit test suite for ReconnectActor, verifying connection recovery, ID conversion, and reconnection process behavior.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem before tests are run.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after tests are completed.

methods.name: conversionBetweenCorrelationIdAndConnectionIdIsOneToOne
methods.description: Tests the bidirectional conversion between ConnectionId and correlation IDs for correctness and uniqueness.

methods.name: testRecoverConnections
methods.description: Verifies that the ReconnectActor properly recovers existing connections from persistence IDs.

methods.name: testRecoverConnectionsIsNotStartedTwice
methods.description: Ensures that the reconnection process is not started multiple times redundantly.
